name: HOA and residents' association records
one_line: A protected Finance template for the holder's continuing relationship with a homeowners', condominium or residents' association: assessments, account notices, governing records, meetings, budgets, architectural decisions and enforcement correspondence, grouped by the explicitly named association rather than by a manager, portal or property address alone.

deterministic: an ASSOCIATION-ASSESSMENT account structure: a homeowners', condominium, cooperative or residents' association is explicitly named in the document title, page-one heading or labelled Association slot; a separately labelled member, owner, unit, lot or parcel slot identifies the obligated side; and assessment charges, due dates, payments and balance rows appear together. A management-company logo or payment processor may identify who produced the record, but it does not replace the association value the roster assigns to institution

a SPECIAL-ASSESSMENT notice structure: an explicitly named association and member or unit reference together with a board action or assessment label, the common project or expense being funded, the apportioned charge, due or installment information, and notice or resolution context. The word assessment is insufficient because a property-tax authority also issues assessment notices

a GOVERNING-RECORD structure whose title or labelled heading identifies a declaration, covenants, conditions and restrictions, bylaws, articles, rules, policy or resolution; whose recitals or definitions name the association or common-interest community; and whose clauses describe membership, assessments, voting, property-use or board authority. The operative clauses may independently activate Legal; association identity and record kind are the Finance-side evidence

an ASSOCIATION-MEETING structure: the association name in the title or heading, a board, member or committee meeting label, a meeting date, attendees or quorum, agenda items, motions and vote or action results. A generic set of corporate minutes or a personal calendar reminder lacks the association-and-governance role pair

an ASSOCIATION-BUDGET or reserve structure: the association is named as the reporting entity, the title or sheet labels an operating budget, financial statement, reserve schedule or reserve study, and populated tables carry assessment income, expenses, fund or component balances and funding or replacement rows. This relies on 00's extraction reality: 'Tables matter because resumes, forms, applications, invoices, and administrative documents often place their most useful information in cells rather than body paragraphs.' A budget year or study date is not a tax_year

an ARCHITECTURAL-REVIEW structure: an association or its committee is explicitly named in an Association, Committee or Decision block; a member and unit or lot are separately labelled; the requested physical change is described; and an approval, denial, conditions or signature result is present. A blank request form or generic renovation guide does not fire

an ENFORCEMENT notice structure: an association or agent acting expressly on its behalf, a separately identified member and unit or lot, a cited covenant or rule, an alleged condition, and cure, hearing, fine or decision language. An address, fine amount or word violation alone is not enough; a live lien, collection or contested proceeding sits on the Legal collision seam

a RESALE-CERTIFICATE or association-status structure signed or certified by an association officer or authorized agent and tied to a unit, with labelled rows for regular or special assessments, delinquency or balance, fees, governing documents, reserve or budget information, violations, insurance or litigation. Its legal and property consequences do not erase the association-record reading

a HOMEOWNER-PORTAL record whose visible labelled slots identify the association, the member or unit account, and a dues, assessment, payment-history, document-library, architectural-review or board-packet function. The platform chrome and management-company brand are source context; the association role must be explicit in the content before institution is available

an archive manifest that co-locates association-shaped members such as declarations, bylaws, rules, minutes, budgets, reserve studies, assessment statements, architectural decisions and notices, inspected without writing members to disk. 00 is explicit: 'Archives should be inspected without being unpacked to disk.' The manifest supports a candidate packet; it does not copy any member's association, owner or record type onto a sibling
needs_llm: whether a management agent, law office, accountant, reserve consultant or portal provider authored a record for an association or is itself the institution the record belongs to. The model resolves labelled roles from bounded regions and must leave institution unknown when the association relationship is only implied

whether prose called rules, declaration, policy, resolution or notice is an operative association record, a generic template, a buyer guide, a news article or a different organization's governance document. The model may interpret the role-bearing clauses but cannot invent that the holder is a member

an OCR-damaged assessment statement, architectural decision or violation notice whose association, management agent, unit and mailing-address roles are partially merged. The model may use layout and nearby labels, but must abstain rather than promote the most frequent organization or address

whether a property identifier is the member's unit or lot, the association's mailing address, a manager's office, a utility service address or a property mentioned in a board discussion. The labelled role decides; a repeated address does not

whether a heterogeneous download is one association relationship, one annual meeting packet, one special-assessment project, one architectural application or one enforcement matter. The model receives a bounded dossier with direct anchors, sparse candidates and conflicts; 00 requires that 'A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.'

whether a manager email is a durable association record, ordinary community news, a maintenance conversation, a solicitation or correspondence in a contested matter. Sender domain and an association signature block support review but never settle the file's function alone

whether a reserve or budget workbook is an association-issued member record or the holder's own bookkeeping work. Repeated vendor names and money columns are shared; the reporting-entity and governance context must be resolved

a multilingual or unfamiliar common-interest-community record whose local terms for association, assessment, meeting, governing instrument or unit have no catalogue entry. The model may map observed structure to record_type, but it cannot import a jurisdiction's legal conclusion
never_alone: the tokens HOA, condo, strata, co-op, community, residents' association or homeowners' association alone. They appear in property listings, buyer guides, news, insurance certificates, vendor proposals and academic papers; a completed association-to-member, governance or account structure must accompany them

an association or community name alone. It may identify the property being insured, a client of a management company, a line in a utility account, a venue, or an entity cited in a dispute. Its labelled role and the record structure matter

a management-company, law-firm, accounting-firm, reserve-consultant, payment-processor or portal-provider name alone. The organization may author or deliver the file without being the association value assigned to institution

a street address, unit, lot, parcel or building name alone. It can be a recipient address, service location, insured property, tax parcel, neighbouring unit or meeting venue. Until its association-member role is labelled it remains an observation
a recurring amount, due date, balance, late fee or payment word alone. Utility bills, loans, insurance, subscriptions, taxes and ordinary receipts all have the same money shape

the word assessment alone. A member assessment needs an association and owner or unit account structure; a public authority's assessed value and tax-year structure belongs to the household-property situation

the words minutes, meeting, notice, rules, covenant, budget, reserve, election or violation alone. Corporate minutes, a personal reminder, a municipal notice and a generic rules template share them without being the holder's association record

a bare year in a filename, budget heading, meeting date, assessment period, reserve-study date or effective-date clause read as tax_year. Only an explicit tax-year slot on an actual tax record can support that field

a source type or extension alone. A PDF is not a covenant, a spreadsheet is not an association budget, an ICS file is not an official meeting notice, a screenshot is not an account record, and a ZIP is not an association packet. 00 requires the engine to 'treat the file extension as a routing signal rather than an assumption about meaning'

an existing HOA folder, portal download batch or tightly bounded session. 00 says, 'A session should never be treated as proof of topic, and it should not carry the same confidence as a hash match or a directly extracted document fact.' Curated structure can seed review but cannot activate Finance or write an association fact

a photograph or sparse scan placed beside minutes, a violation or an architectural request. It may join an accepted matter as a reviewable member, but 00's firewall remains: 'The graph does not automatically copy those missing facts onto sparse files.'

missing EXIF on a portal or document image as proof that it is a screenshot. 00 says 'the system must not mistake the absence of EXIF for proof that an image is a screenshot'; 'conflicting signals should lead to abstention rather than an invented classification'
an unreadable file named HOA Documents, Covenants, Dues or Violation. Unreadable material can be manually attached later, but its filename and neighbours cannot establish purpose
recognition.proposed_context_terms_note: PROPOSED, not design. These are candidate role and document-kind terms harvested from the fixtures and current primary sources. R6 owns any term patterns and R4 owns organization-gazetteer contents; this node writes neither a regex nor a score.

grouping_reasons: one continuing member relationship with one explicitly identified association across assessment statements, receipts, governing documents, meetings, budgets, architectural decisions and notices. The association-role evidence is the anchor; the manager, address or portal brand alone is not

one member assessment account across periodic statements, a special assessment, payment confirmations, delinquency correspondence and a paid-in-full status letter. A stable labelled owner or account reference supports membership; no member name, balance or record_type propagates to a sparse email

one annual or special meeting packet across the notice, agenda, proxy, ballot, board packet, presentation and minutes. Structured association and meeting identifiers anchor it; the shared date or calendar adjacency alone does not

one architectural request across the application, plans, photographs, committee correspondence and final decision. The completed application or decision is the anchor; photographs can join without acquiring institution, account_holder or record_type

one enforcement matter across the initial notice, resident response, hearing notice, decision, cure evidence and any later legal correspondence. The routine association record and Legal matter may overlap as groups while each file keeps only its own facts

one capital project or special assessment across the board resolution, budget, reserve-study excerpt, assessment notice, contractor proposal and progress correspondence. Purpose coherence may support the packet; it cannot turn a contractor proposal into the resident's assessment statement
one portal export or records-request packet represented by an archive manifest and its individually extracted members, without unpacking or copying member facts onto the container
one file saved twice or revised after a board action, represented by duplicate_family and version_family rather than by an association fact

one file may participate in several accepted groups: covenants in an association packet and a Legal packet, a portal capture in Photos and Finance, or an assessment receipt in the association account and a transaction packet. 00 allows this directly: 'A file may validly belong to more than one accepted group'

template.why: institution first, carrying the roster's explicit instruction that the value is the association. An association relationship is more stable than the management company, portal, lawyer, accountant, consultant or contractor that may produce one record, and a leaf such as minutes or violation notice is not intelligible until the association is known. record_type follows as the useful functional split among statements, governing documents, meetings, budgets, architectural decisions and notices. account_type is omitted by default: a unit or lot is a property relationship, not a kind of financial account, and most residents have one association relationship per property. It remains available only when the record itself labels genuinely distinct member, assessment or ledger accounts and the resulting level materially separates records. tax_year is omitted because a budget year, meeting year, assessment period, reserve-study date, effective date and violation date do not answer the tax-year role; only an explicit tax-year slot on an actual association tax record can fill it. A multi-property holder exposes the current vocabulary gap: the visible finance.household-property proposal for property must be adjudicated in R1c before this node can recommend property as a level, so property or unit labels remain observations and group anchors here. The current order is intentionally shallow and not time-first, following 00: 'For document and record domains, project, function, or subject usually comes before time because putting year first scatters related work across calendar folders.' Where institution would create only one branch, the interface should follow 00 and 'recommend flattening when a dimension does not materially improve retrieval.' Nothing is frozen: 'The system recommends an order based on the domain template, but the user can reverse, remove, add, or flatten dimensions.' This is a placeholder over a Finance safety domain, not authority to expose names, addresses or account details.

collides_with.signal: Reciprocates the current neighbour draft. An association assessment and a general property record share the unit address, owner name and money figures. Dues, member-account, association-governance, meeting, covenant or architectural-review structure points here; acquisition, title, public property-tax, inspection, improvement, permit and installed-system structure points to finance.household-property. A unit address, property-manager name or the word assessment alone counts for neither.

Reciprocates the current neighbour draft. An association dues notice and a utility or recurring-service bill both name an organization, repeat, carry a property address and request payment. Association, member or unit, assessment, governance, meeting or covenant structure points here; a metered service, usage unit, rate plan, service identifier, paid plan or subscription lifecycle points to finance.subscriptions-utilities. The address and recurring amount decide neither.

A member assessment statement and a bank, card or deposit statement can carry the same labelled period, account, charge, payment and balance slots. The discriminator is who holds what: an explicitly named association plus member or unit assessment structure belongs here; a financial institution plus deposit, card or cash-account descriptor and beginning or ending balance structure belongs to finance.personal-records. A management company sender, masked identifier or balance cannot fill both readings.

A dues payment receipt and an ordinary purchase receipt each carry a named organization, transaction reference, date and amount. An explicit association, member or unit account and assessment or dues context makes the receipt part of the continuing association relationship; seller, order and item-total structure with no standing association evidence makes it a one-off transaction. When only the payment confirmation lands, Receipts and Confirmations is the honest broad home.

An association budget, general ledger or reserve workbook and a small operation's books can be structurally identical: reporting period, account rows, debits, credits, expenses and balances. The reporting entity and governance purpose discriminate: an association named in the report with assessments, common expenses, reserves or board-adoption context belongs here; the holder's own operation, customers, vendors, invoice register and reconciliations belong to finance.small-business-bookkeeping. Possession by a board member or an HOA-named folder is not business ownership evidence.

An association master policy or certificate is commonly downloaded from the same portal as budgets and governing documents and names the association prominently. A carrier, Named Insured, policy number, coverage line, limit and term structure belongs to finance.insurance-corporate, where institution is the carrier and the association is the holder; an association-issued assessment, governance, meeting, architecture or enforcement structure belongs here. The association name and portal provenance cannot choose between them.

A recorded declaration, covenant packet or association contract can be both an association record and an operative instrument, with organization names, numbered clauses and signatures. Party recitals, obligations and an execution block creating or amending duties are the legal-agreement evidence; association-to-member account, governance, meeting or administrative-record structure is this template's evidence. Governing documents may activate Finance and Legal on disjoint evidence; one association name or one clause must not be counted twice to force either reading.

A routine violation or hearing notice and a live legal matter share the association, member, rule citation, deadline and possible monetary charge. An association enforcement form offering cure, hearing or board review belongs here; a filed lien, collection demand, attorney correspondence, court or tribunal caption, settlement, appeal or contested-proceeding structure belongs to legal.personal-legal-matters. The allegation, address and amount are shared evidence and settle neither side.

falls_through_to.why: The roster-required default for a readable, durable association notice or form whose deeper relationship does not land. 00 defines Independent Records for 'standalone certificates, notices, confirmations, forms, and PDFs that have a durable purpose but no broader group.' Fixtures: Special Assessment Notice - Roof Replacement.pdf, Bylaws - Oak Ridge HOA.pdf and Oak Ridge HOA Annual Meeting.ics.

Owner statements, ballots, violation notices, architectural decisions and resale certificates expose addresses, balances, signatures, votes or allegations even when no accepted association group exists. 00's residual covers 'sensitive isolated material such as passport scans, medical documents, account statements, visas, legal forms, or credentials' and says it 'should normally remain local-only and must not cause filenames or content to be exposed in model prompts.'

An isolated dues payment confirmation with no accepted association relationship is still the broad transaction 00 names among 'isolated invoices, delivery confirmations, booking records, boarding passes, purchase receipts, event tickets, and similar transactional documents.' Fixture: HOA Payment Receipt - 2026-04-01.eml.

00 defines this residual for 'screenshots that appear time-sensitive or remind the user of something but have no accepted project, trip, application, or event relationship.' A portal balance capture with no accepted association account belongs there rather than in a folder inferred from its pixels. Fixture: Owner Portal - Account Balance.png.

00 defines this residual for 'images with no event, project, reference collection, or photo-family association.' A camera photo of an unreadable community bulletin remains a capture when no association record or meeting group lands. Fixture: IMG_9034.HEIC.

00 defines it for 'files whose meaning is partly understood but whose final location requires a future decision.' A mixed archive manifest or cropped notice can be recognizably administrative without establishing the association, record role or member relationship. Fixtures: HOA_Documents.zip and association_notice_scan.pdf.

00 defines this residual for 'password-protected archives, unreadable documents, damaged files, and unknown formats.' An encrypted portal download remains represented and manually attachable without inferring association purpose from its filename. Fixture: Resident_Portal_Download.zip.

00 defines Reading Inbox for 'papers, articles, reports, and saved PDFs that appear to be reading material but have no active research, course, or project association.' A general consumer guide about association rules is reading material, not proof of the holder's association relationship. Fixture: Understanding Condo Association Rules.pdf.

sensitivity_why: This template inherits Finance's safety posture. 00 requires: 'Finance, identity, medical, and legal material should be implemented first as safety domains, meaning the system detects and protects them before any cloud or automated placement decision is allowed.' Association files can expose the holder's exact unit or property address, owner balance and payment history, member and resident contact data, signatures, ballots and proxies, architectural plans, alleged violations, hearing material, access or gate information, and resale or lien risk. The strongest subsets also resemble account statements and legal forms. 00 says, 'Protected material should not be included in cloud-model prompts by default, should not display raw content in general group summaries, and should not be moved automatically without a user policy that explicitly permits it.' Only potentially_sensitive is authored here; D2's classification authority and P7's handling-class vocabulary are not duplicated or assigned.
open_question: Two Joseph decisions remain. First, the roster says institution holds the association, while the canonical role is the financial or record-issuing institution and many records are produced by a management agent, portal, lawyer, accountant, consultant or insurer. This row follows the roster only when the association role is explicit and leaves the producer as an observation, but R1c must decide whether that is a permitted 'record belongs to' reading or whether a distinct association key is required. If property becomes canonical, R1c must also choose association then property versus property then association for multi-property holders; until then the order remains institution then record_type. Second, the roster intentionally includes covenants, minutes and violations inside a Finance template even though those records are not intrinsically financial. Should the template own the whole association relationship with Legal co-activation for operative or contested files, as this row models, or should its boundary shrink to assessments and administration while Legal becomes primary for governance and enforcement? The placeholder remains useful either way, and no field or handling class is minted to prejudge either answer.
